# Combined Bearing Source — LLM / AI crawler index

> China industrial bearing manufacturer for combined bearings, track roller bearings, full-complement cylindrical roller bearings, back-up rollers, cross roller bearings, Standard NbV profiles, and special track rollers. Factory-direct OEM and replacement supply from Changzhou with Shanghai export sales.

## Model references
Winkel 4.053–4.096, PR4.054–PR4.056 / PR4.058–PR4.063, eccentric 4.454–4.463, welded-plate AP0/AP1/AP2/AP2-LUB/AP2-Q/AP3.1/AP4/AP6/AP91-Q, NUTR25–40 / NUTR45100 / NUTR50110, NNTR, NUKR35–110, KRV16-PP through KRV90-PP, NATR5-PP through NATR50-PP, NATV5-PP through NATV50-PP, LFR, SL04, SL18 2205–2206, SL18 3004–3010, SL18 1832 / 4860, NCF, CSF, SHF, and AKD.

## Inquiry details
Provide the bearing model, dimensions, quantity, application, load direction, speed, accuracy or clearance, sealing preference, destination, and drawings or photos when available.
